top_sast_rules.description: An authorization check exists but evaluates access incorrectly.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-863 incorrect-authorization authorization-check permission-check role-check ownership-check acl-check access-decision bypass
top_sast_rules.remediation: Evaluate authorization from trusted server-side identity and policy state.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
top_sast_rules.description: URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Validate redirect URLs against allowlists. Use relative URLs where possible and avoid user-controlled redirects.

top_sast_rules.description: A restricted route, URL, script, or file can be requested directly without required authorization.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-425 forced-browsing direct-request restricted-url protected-route protected-file missing-authorization route endpoint hidden-link
top_sast_rules.remediation: Authorize every protected route and resource on direct access.

top_sast_rules.description: Security checks on the substrings of an unparsed URL are often vulnerable to bypassing.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement strict input validation using allowlists and reject invalid input rather than attempting to sanitize it.

top_sast_rules.description: Not using `pam_acct_mgmt` after `pam_authenticate` to check the validity of a login can lead to authorization bypass.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to this vulnerability type. Review the query logic for detailed requirements.

top_sast_rules.description: A security-relevant comparison checks the wrong, incomplete, or non-canonical value.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-697 incorrect-comparison equality compare comparator mismatch canonicalization hostname url signature token partial-comparison substring
top_sast_rules.remediation: Compare canonical complete values with the intended security predicate.

top_sast_rules.description: Making a network request to a URL that is partially user-controlled allows for request forgery attacks.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement URL validation with allowlists of permitted destinations. Use network segmentation and validate all outbound requests.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
top_sast_rules.description: Untrusted CR or LF characters are not neutralized before use in line-delimited protocol metadata.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-93 crlf-injection carriage-return line-feed newline header response-splitting http-header redirect cookie
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject CR/LF in protocol metadata and use validating framework APIs.

top_sast_rules.description: Security-critical data assumed immutable can be modified by an attacker.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-471 assumed-immutable immutable-data hidden-field cookie reverse-dns attacker-modified trusted-value mutable security-decision
top_sast_rules.remediation: Do not trust client-modifiable values as immutable security state.

top_sast_rules.description: Deserializing user-controlled data may allow attackers to execute arbitrary code.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Identify deserialization operations on untrusted data without proper validation
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use safe serialization formats like JSON. If complex deserialization is needed, implement strict validation and type checking.
